_note: Reference map for the Douay-Rheims / Latin Vulgate Bible (e.g. the Project Gutenberg edition). Point config `reference_maps` at this file so its Latin/Catholic book names resolve to canonical OSIS books. Covers the UNAMBIGUOUS renamings only. Two things it deliberately does NOT do — confirm them per document instead: (1) the Vulgate Kings/Samuel shift (Douay '1-2 Kings' = Samuel, '3-4 Kings' = Kings) is a genuine canon divergence that would corrupt a Protestant text if applied blindly; (2) the deuterocanonical books (Tobias, Judith, Wisdom, Ecclesiasticus/Sirach, Baruch, 1-2 Machabees) are NOT in the 66-book canon this engine ships, so they have no canonical key yet — the confirm step lets you keep them as their own works until Catholic/Orthodox canon support lands.

Revelation: Apocalypse of St. John the Apostle

key_aliases._note: Add versification remaps here if this edition's chapter:verse numbering diverges from your canonical frame (the Vulgate Psalms are numbered differently from the Hebrew for much of the Psalter). Format: {"bible:Ps.<this-edition>.<v>": "bible:Ps.<canonical>.<v>"}.
